schematic.text:
If using RP2354 (internal flash), remove R10.
R9 can be fit to use U3 as secondary memory.

Note: S1 schematic revision indicates that this is the 1st revision of the schematic/BOM associated with the R4 PCB.
R4-S1 therefore uniquely identifies the fully built PCB Assembly (PCBA).
This is a change from the previous revision numbering to align with the internal Raspberry Pi product revisioning scheme
Make sure R7 and R8 are close to RP2350
